weakness: Shared break-glass database role used for routine fixes; access reviews cover the identity provider only; contractor accounts outside single sign-on survived offboarding
source: P07 assessment (AC-02 objectives); P01 R-002, R-015; SOC 2 Type 1 exception 1
remediation_plan: Named just-in-time database access with approval; retire the shared role; SSO-only repository membership; quarterly reviews of cloud roles, database users, repository, staging, and admin console; contractor end dates in People Operations tickets
milestones: 2026-09-04 contractor accounts removed (done); 2026-10-23 shared role retired; 2026-12-31 first full quarterly review
resources_required: Privileged access tool ($18K per year, shared with POAM-003)

weakness: CI keys with broad production permissions; break-glass role for routine work; all engineers can write to staging
remediation_plan: Scope CI credentials per pipeline job; read-only default roles; staging write limited to 4 platform engineers until the purge
milestones: 2026-10-16 CI permissions scoped; 2026-10-30 staging access reduced

weakness: Privileged SQL under the shared role is not logged or attributable; security page claim that every access is logged is not accurate
remediation_plan: Database session recording through the privileged access tool; correct the security page now and restore the claim only after recording is live
milestones: 2026-10-15 security page corrected; 2026-10-23 session recording live

weakness: No review of cloud audit logs, privileged sessions, or view-as-tenant sessions
remediation_plan: Weekly privileged activity review and monthly view-as-tenant review with a written checklist; findings reported to the CTO
milestones: 2026-11-02 first weekly review; 2026-11-30 first monthly view-as-tenant review
resources_required: IT Manager time (2 hours per week)

weakness: Two long-lived static CI cloud keys (412 and 530 days old); third-party API keys never rotated, one in repository history; no leaked-credential procedure
source: P07; P01 R-001, R-030; P04 finding 1; P08 scenario
remediation_plan: Replace static keys with federated short-lived workload credentials; rotate all third-party keys into the secrets manager; push protection for secrets; written revoke-and-replace procedure (P08)
milestones: 2026-10-09 federated credentials in CI; 2026-10-16 static keys deleted and third-party keys rotated

weakness: Object access to the payroll export bucket and database queries are not logged; event list never reviewed
remediation_plan: Turn on object-level access logging for customer data buckets and database audit logging for privileged sessions; document event types and rationale; review annually
milestones: 2026-10-31 object and database logging on; 2026-11-15 event list approved
resources_required: Log storage ($12K per year, shared with POAM-007 and POAM-008)

weakness: No threat detection or alerts for unusual API calls, bulk object reads, or snapshot copies
remediation_plan: Enable the provider threat detection service; alerts for API calls from unknown networks, bulk reads, snapshot copy or share; route to on-call
milestones: 2026-10-16 threat detection on; 2026-11-30 custom alerts tested with a simulated bulk read

weakness: Cloud audit logs kept only 90 days and application logs 30 days
remediation_plan: Export cloud audit and object access logs to a separate log archive account with 1-year retention that production administrators cannot change
milestones: 2026-11-30 archive account live

weakness: Tenant isolation tests cover 80% of endpoints and do not block merges; no security or privacy test plan; no static analysis
remediation_plan: Isolation tests for 100% of endpoints as a merge gate; database-level row security as a second layer; static analysis in CI; written security and privacy test plan
milestones: 2026-11-30 merge gate live; 2027-01-31 row security in production

weakness: Staging refreshed monthly from unmasked production data without approval; staging less protected than production
source: P07; P03 G-003; P01 R-003; SOC 2 Type 1 exception 2
remediation_plan: Stop production refreshes; purge existing copies with evidence; synthetic and masked test data; protect staging at production level until the purge is confirmed
milestones: 2026-09-30 refreshes stopped; 2026-10-30 copies purged and verified

weakness: No sub-processor security review or SOC 2 report review; AI model provider on click-through terms with short notice
source: P07; P03 G-021, G-022, G-036; P01 R-004, R-019; SOC 2 Type 1 exception 3
remediation_plan: Tiered sub-processor review program with annual SOC 2 and CUEC review (P09 vendor-soc2-review.csv); signed DPA with the model provider; re-notice customers with a 30-day objection window
milestones: 2026-10-15 re-notice sent; 2026-10-30 all 6 sub-processor reports reviewed; 2026-10-31 model provider DPA signed

weakness: No contingency or disaster recovery plan
remediation_plan: Write the DR plan and regional recovery runbook from the BIA (P05), including the regional RPO decision, contacts, and roles
milestones: 2026-12-15 draft; 2027-01-31 approved and distributed

weakness: One restore test (5 hours against a 2-hour RTO); no failover test; no corrective action
source: P07; P05 key finding 1; P01 R-006
remediation_plan: Semiannual restore and regional failover tests run by a second engineer, with results reviewed by the CTO
milestones: 2026-12-15 first restore test under the new runbook; 2027-01-31 first failover test

weakness: Backups in the production account can be deleted with production; documentation not backed up
remediation_plan: Separate backup account with write-once retention and separate credentials; back up runbooks and security documentation
milestones: 2026-11-15 account created; 2026-12-15 copies verified

weakness: No severity scheme, forensic retainer, exercise, or lessons-learned records
remediation_plan: Adopt POL-03 severity scheme and the P08 runbook; forensic retainer; tabletop exercise of the P08 scenario; lessons-learned template
milestones: 2026-09-22 POL-03 and P08 approved (done); 2026-11-18 tabletop; 2026-11-30 retainer signed

weakness: Customer notice step did not match the 72-hour and 48-hour DPA terms; no customer security contact list
remediation_plan: P08 notification matrix and customer notice template; security contact for every customer, verified quarterly
milestones: 2026-09-22 matrix approved (done); 2026-10-31 contact list complete

weakness: Image findings not triaged or enforced; no remediation timelines

milestones: 2026-10-31 timelines approved; 2026-11-30 deploy gate live

weakness: Terminated customers' data kept past 90 days; payroll exports kept since 2022; personal data in application logs
remediation_plan: Delete the 14 former tenants after contract check; automated tenant deletion with evidence; lifecycle rule for payroll exports; log redaction
milestones: 2026-10-31 lifecycle rule; 2026-11-30 tenants deleted and deletion job live; 2026-12-31 log redaction

weakness: No secure coding or role-based security training for engineers
remediation_plan: Annual secure coding course for all 21 engineers; incident response training for on-call staff
milestones: 2026-11-18 on-call training before the tabletop; 2026-12-15 secure coding complete

weakness: Administrator bypass of branch protection; no security and privacy impact step; bypasses not reviewed
source: P07; P02 AC-5 and CM-3; P03 G-019
remediation_plan: Remove bypass rights; documented emergency change path reviewed within 1 business day; security and privacy review step in design (POL-01 4.8)
